sn35.240:1.1: bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave, kummo kacchapo sāyanhasamayaṃ anu nadītīre gocarapasuto ahosi;
sn35.240:1.2: sigālopi kho bhikkhave sāyanhasamayaṃ anunadītīre gocarapasuto hoti.
sn35.240:1.3: addasā kho bhikkhave kummo kacchapo sigālaṃ dūratova gocarapasutaṃ.
sn35.240:1.4: disvāna soṇḍi pañcamāni aṅgāni sake kapāle samodahitvā appossukko tuṇhī bhūto saṃkasāyati.
sn35.240:1.5: sigālopi kho bhikkhave addasa kummaṃ kacchapā dūratova,
sn35.240:1.6: disvāna yena kummo kacchapo tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā kummaṃ kacchapaṃ paccupaṭṭhito ahosi;
sn35.240:1.7: yadāyaṃ kummo kacchapo soṇḍipañcamānaṃ aṅgānaṃ aññataraṃ vā aññataraṃ vā aṅgaṃ abhininnāmessati, tattheva naṃ gahetvā uddālitvā khādissāmīti.
sn35.240:1.8: yadā kho bhikkhave kummo kacchapo soṇḍipañcamānaṃ aṅgānaṃ aññataraṃ vā aññataraṃ vā aṅgaṃ na abhininnāmesi, atha sigālo kummamhā nibbijja pakkami. otāraṃ alabhamāno.
sn35.240:2.1: evameva kho bhikkhave tumhepi māro pāpimā satataṃ samitaṃ paccupaṭṭhito;
sn35.240:2.2: ‘appevanāmāhaṃ imesaṃ cakkhuto vā otāraṃ labheyyaṃ, sotatovā otāraṃ labheyyaṃ, ghānatovā otāraṃ labheyyaṃ,
sn35.240:2.3: jivhāto vā otāraṃ labheyyaṃ, kāyatovā otāraṃ labheyyaṃ,
sn35.240:2.6: cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā mā nimittaggāhino ahuvattha, mānubyañjanaggāhino.
sn35.240:2.7: yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjatha, rakkhatha cakkhundriyaṃ, cakkhundriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjatha.
sn35.240:2.12: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya mā nimittaggāhino ahuvattha, mānubyañjanaggāhino.
sn35.240:2.13: yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ manindriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjatha, rakkhatha manindriyaṃ, manindriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjatha.
sn35.240:2.14: yato kho tumhe bhikkhave, indriyesu guttadvārā viharissatha, atha tumhehipi māro pāpimā nibbijja pakkamissati, otāraṃ alabhamāno
